rules.description: Applicant in England or Northern Ireland must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to register to vote in England or Northern Ireland

rules.description: Applicant in Scotland or Wales must be at least 14 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 14 years old to register to vote in Scotland or Wales

rules.description: Applicant must have a UK address (or be an overseas voter with previous UK address)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have a UK address to register. If you live abroad, use the overseas voter service.

rules.description: Applicant in England/Northern Ireland must be British, Irish, qualifying Commonwealth or EU citizen
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a British, Irish, Commonwealth (with permission to stay), or qualifying EU citizen to register in England or Northern Ireland

rules.description: Applicant in Scotland/Wales must have permission to stay in UK or not need permission
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have permission to enter or stay in the UK, or not need permission, to register in Scotland or Wales

edge_cases.description: Applicant needs anonymous registration due to safety concerns
edge_cases.action: Route to anonymous registration process. Contact local Electoral Registration Office.

edge_cases.description: Applicant lives abroad and wants to register as overseas voter
edge_cases.action: Route to overseas voter registration service. Requires previous UK address and passport details. Registration must be renewed every 3 years.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is in Northern Ireland (different registration system)
edge_cases.action: Route to Electoral Office for Northern Ireland (EONI) registration system.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a Crown servant or British Council employee
edge_cases.action: Route to specialized registration process for Crown servants and British Council employees.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a member of the armed forces
edge_cases.action: Route to armed forces voter registration service.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is moving and needs to update both old and new addresses
edge_cases.action: De-register from old Electoral Registration Office and register at new address.
